units.source_text: 等啊等啊，京部终于没有遭到空袭。

en.t: After waiting and waiting, Kyoto was never bombed after all.

units.source_text: 翌年3月9日，传来了东京小工商业区一带成为一片火海的消息，

en.t: On March 9 of the following year, news arrived that the small commercial and industrial districts of Tokyo had become a sea of fire,

units.source_text: 可灾祸离京都很远，京都显现的只是一片早春澄明的天空。

en.t: but the calamity was far from Kyoto, where all that appeared was the clear sky of early spring.
